reference_checks.comparability_caveat: Historical local figures differ in period and geography; independent Meteostat figures are meteorological stations, not census-weighted residential neighborhood figures.

examples.interpretation: County includes high mountains; cannot proxy LiuKu residential altitude or climate
Valley vs mountainous county average; county mean would materially distort comfort rating
Different spatial sampling and reference period; requires residential grid rather than county mean
Annual temperature reasonably close; precipitation discrepancy needs station-period check; coldest monthly mean maximum is not provided by Bio1

findings.detail: Original archive downloadable, has valid separate Bio1 and Bio12 GeoTIFFs, raster units credible, 2838/2847 counties successfully extracted.
Scientific source is publicly published peer-reviewed gridded interpolation, not directly observed climate normals at each residential neighborhood.

Current extraction uses administrative polygon mean; retirement customer table units are specific towns, valleys, urban built-up areas; observed -8.53°C city-vs-county mismatch, therefore direct column fill or A-D rating from county means is unsafe.
Nine 236-row candidate administrative codes lack strict code+name polygon identity, so Bio1 Bio12 remain null until geometry is checked.
Existing CSV valid_fraction field is currently written as 1.0 rather than calculated valid pixels / total spatial cells; treat this field as invalid for data-quality decisions.
Bio1 only annual mean temperature; Bio12 only total annual precipitation. Neither is a measure of coldest-month average daily maximum, heatwave days, humidity or rainy days.

decision.next_action: Target exact named residential towns/urban settled-population grids in the 236 units, sample Bio1/Bio12 at settlement pixels with altitude-aware checks; present source and confidence, and compare to historical station/local figures before assigning per-parameter grades
